sections.h2: Experience the Vibe at Labs Cannabis
sections.body: Visiting Labs Cannabis is more than just a shopping trip; it’s an experience! Situated near the vibrant Pattaya 13 Alley and Walking Street, our dispensary boasts a welcoming atmosphere where everyone can feel at home. This site publishes no prices, no stock lists and no advertising: Thai law reads that as cannabis advertising, and the penalty lands on the shop's licence. Our team is passionate about cannabis culture and is eager to share their knowledge with you. Whether you’re a cannabis connoisseur or new to the scene, we ensure a friendly and informative environment for all our customers.

Since 26 June 2025 cannabis flower has been a controlled herb in Thailand. It is dispensed in person, in the shop, to adults aged 20 or older who present a prescription issued by a licensed practitioner in Thailand; such a prescription covers a course of up to 30 days. Prescriptions issued abroad are not accepted, and flower may not be taken out of the country.

faq.a: We offer a variety of cannabis strains, including popular options like White Widow, as well as many others to cater to different preferences.
Identification that shows you are 20 or older and a valid Thai prescription. Both are checked at the counter before anything is handed over.

faq.q: Do you sell vapes or e-cigarettes?
faq.a: No. Selling vapes and e-cigarettes is illegal in Thailand and we do not stock them. Labs Cannabis is a licensed cannabis dispensary.
